name: cfg-gateway-idle-nosweep
about: gateway.idleSweepIntervalSeconds=0 关闭空闲扫描（SessionRouter.ts:104 只在间隔 >0 时起定时器）：超时虽然很短，会话仍留在缓存里；对照 cfg-gateway-idle-evict。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
gateway:
  idleSessionTimeoutMinutes: 0.005
  idleSweepIntervalSeconds: 0
